t: This is North Audley Street, in Mayfair. It runs from the northwest corner of Grosvenor Square up to Oxford Street, where it carries on as Orchard Street. Two people are linked to the street. Hugh Kindersley, the second Baron Kindersley, lived here. He was a British Army officer, businessman and banker, and the son of the first Baron Kindersley. Cicely Champion de Crespigny, who lived from 1874 to 1946, died here. It is a quiet, well-connected corner of Mayfair.
